newsitem.title: USA: Autumn Jackson considers taking genetic test - WCBS.
newsitem.headline: Autumn Jackson considers taking genetic test - WCBS.

text.p: The woman convicted of extorting $40 million from entertainer Bill Cosby is considering his offer to take a blood test to determine if he is her father, WCBS radio reported on Tuesday.

Lawyers for Autumn Jackson said she might take the test, but only after her sentencing in October, the radio reported. Cosby had previously backed out of a paternity test, but on Monday Cosby's lawyer said the entertainer had given blood to resolve the issue.
Earlier on Tuesday, Wanda Akin, the lawyer for Jackson's mother, Shawn Thompson, said that neither woman would participate in the test.
"We won't respond to some grandstanding move," Akin said in an interview with the cable news network MSNBC.

Jackson, 22, was convicted last Friday in New York of threatening to go to a tabloid newspaper with her story that Cosby was her father unless Cosby paid her $40 million. Her attorney said she grew up believing Cosby was her father.
The actor has admitted having an affair with Jackson's mother and paying for Jackson's education, but he denies he is her father.
The judge in the federal extortion case ruled that any discussion of Cosby's paternity was irrelevant.
Jackson faces up to 12 years in prison.
